Greedy Meshing for Vertex Colored Voxels In Unity - Eddie Abbondanz
This article goes over how to implement a greedy meshing algorithm for generating optimized meshes for vertex-colored voxels in Unity. The algorithm is derived from Robert O'Leary, with a few alterations made. The setup has been simplified, and assumes the world is only comprised of a single chunk that holds all the blocks.
